title: Gina, taƙaitawa kuma bincika takardar bin diddigin ku

say: Gina, taƙaitawa da bincika takardar bin diddigin ku a cikin Google Sheets.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na 2 na Rahoto da Bibiyar Ayyuka.

Google Sheets app ne na maƙunsar rubutu kyauta wanda ke aiki akan wayarka. Ƙa'idar zinariya shine jere ɗaya a kowane rikodin. Kowane jere taron ne guda ɗaya, kamar siyarwa ɗaya. Kowane ginshiƙi yana riƙe da nau'ikan bayanai ɗaya, kamar kwanan wata ko abun.
Yi amfani da jerin zaɓuka, don haka koyaushe ana rubuta WhatsApp iri ɗaya, kuma kiyaye jimlar akan wani shafin Takaitaccen bayani.

panel.heading: Jeri ɗaya a kowace rikodin

say: Guji layuka marasa komai, haɗe-haɗen sel da jimlar da aka buga a tsakiyar bayanan ku. Kuma rubuta lambobi kawai, ba tare da alamar naira ba. Waɗannan halaye masu sauƙi sune abin da ke barin ƙididdiga da sigogi suyi aiki daga baya.

say: Yi rikodin kowane tallace-tallace da zaran ya faru. Shigar da duka mako guda daga ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya a daren Lahadi yana haifar da asarar tallace-tallace.

card.title: Layukan farko na Bisi guda uku
card.note: Adadi = adadi x farashin raka'a, ta dabara.

say: Bisi yana rubuta adadin da farashin, kuma tsari yana aiki akan kowane adadin: 7,500, 6,000 da 3,000 naira. Rukuninta da aka biya shi ne Ee ko A'a.

panel.heading: Dabaru shida za ku yi amfani da su
items: COUNTIF: yana ƙidaya sel waɗanda suka dace
SUMIF: yana ƙara layuka masu dacewa kawai
Canjin kashi: sabo ya rage tsoho, sama da tsoho

say: SUM yana ƙara tallace-tallace ku. AVERAGE yana samun matsakaicin siyarwa. COUNTA tana ƙididdige layuka nawa kuke da su.

say: A karshen watan Maris, SUM na Bisi ya nuna Naira 280,000 a kasuwa.
SUMIF dinta ta raba ta ta tashar: 142,000 akan WhatsApp, shiga 98,000 da 40,000 akan Instagram.
Waɗannan sun haɗa har zuwa 280,000, wanda ya tabbatar da cewa babu abin da ya ɓace.

say: Fabrairu ya kasance 250,000. 280,000 debe 250,000, raba ta 250,000, shine 12%.

say: Manufarta ita ce 300,000, don haka ta kai kashi 93.3% na abin da aka sa gaba.

say: Kuma COUNTIF yana nuna oda 5 har yanzu ba a biya ba. Wadancan basussukan da ake bi.

panel.heading: Bisi's Maris taƙaitawa
panel.rule: Bincika jimlar rukunin suna ƙara zuwa jimillar jimillar.

say: Lokacin da lamba ya riga ya zama kashi, yi hankali. Idan juyi ya tashi daga 20% zuwa 25%, ragi yana ba da maki 5 cikin ɗari.
Raba 5 da 20 yana ba da 25% karuwa. Dukansu daidai ne, amma sun bambanta sosai.
Halin aminci shine rubuta: sama da maki 5, daga 20% zuwa 25%. Sai mai karatu ya ga canji na gaske.
Layi ɗaya da aka kwafi, ko farashin da aka buga tare da ƙarin sifili, na iya juya wata mara ƙarfi zuwa babba akan takarda. Don haka duba kowane mako. Da farko, kunna tace.

card.title: Bisi ta sasanta da app ɗin biyanta
card.note: Bambanci: odar waya ɗaya bai taɓa shiga ba.

say: App dinta ya nuna naira 68,500 ya shigo, takardar ta ya nuna 63,500 kacal.

card.title: Bisi ta sasanta da app ɗin biyanta
rows: Sheet: canja wurin da aka biya
card.note: Bambanci: odar waya ɗaya bai taɓa shiga ba.

say: Bambancin Naira 5,000 ne. Ta sami odar wayar da ba a shiga ba, ta ƙara, sannan ta lura da gyaran.
Idan kuɗi na sirri ya shiga cikin asusu ɗaya, adana asusun kasuwanci daban, ko sanya alamar canja wurin sirri a fili don kada a ƙidaya su azaman tallace-tallace.

card.title: Bisi ta sasanta da app ɗin biyanta
rows: Sheet: canja wurin da aka biya
card.note: Bambanci: odar waya ɗaya bai taɓa shiga ba.

say: Don tunawa. Layi ɗaya a kowane taron. Yi amfani da zazzagewa, kuma rubuta lambobi ba tare da alamar naira ba. Bari tsari yayi kirgawa. Yi haske game da maki kashi. Kuma bincika bayananku kowane mako akan app ɗin bankin ku, lura da kowane gyara.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Jeri ɗaya a kowace aukuwa, shafi ɗaya kowane daki-daki
Dropdowns suna ci gaba da rubutun iri ɗaya
SUM, COUNTIF, SUMIF da canjin kashi
Bincika mako-mako kuma daidaita tare da app ɗin bankin ku

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Gina bayanan bayananku tare da bayyanannun kanun labarai, zazzagewa da rikodin gaske guda biyar. Ƙara Taƙaitaccen shafin tare da jimlar da ci gaba a kan manufa. Sa'an nan kuma gudanar da binciken farko na bayanan ku kuma fara shafin Bayanan kula.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
